answer: Sponsor-backed entry blocks fake identities. Each newcomer needs a sponsor locking 100 POA for 20 epochs, like shale strata; a cheating newcomer costs the sponsor 30%. One sponsor backs at most 3 agents, so N fakes need N/3 paid sponsors charging fees. Idle reputation drifts like a zephyr: 10 idle epochs fade the lotus score to zero. Cost ledger: N fakes pay N x 100 POA locked plus fees; one honest agent pays one fee and keeps rewards undiluted.
